mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized over 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months indicates strong economic demand, which positively correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals a tightening labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a supply shock, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points, signals a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the past five months indicates strong economic growth, which positively correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increases.
